verdict.rationale: Versioning, review, and rollback are fair questions for a workflow-automation platform like Skyvern, but the evidence pack never mentions workflow version history, change review, diffing, or rollback. The visual builder, template sharing, and code-first SDK do not establish any built-in versioning capability. Code-based automations could in principle be kept in external source control, but that is not documented as a Skyvern feature.
